episode_summary: Kim Rittberg discusses the importance of integrating personal content into social media strategies to boost engagement and build connections. She emphasizes the use of video content, both long and short-form, to establish credibility and maintain client relationships. The episode offers actionable insights for real estate agents looking to enhance their personal brand and client engagement.
